title: Re-Banning the Re-Banished: Levels 3 & 4 II
description: Re-Banning the Re-Banished: Levels 3 & 4 II — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Yakov Smearnov

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Go to the golded farms on Level 3, the branch off of Level 3, Level 4, and the branch off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag and slay the Banned Farmers. Also, collect 15 Golded Pumpkins and 30 Golded Ears o' Corn then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Yakov Smearnov

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to the golded farms on Level 3, the branch off of Level 3, Level 4, and the branch off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag and slay the Banned Farmers. Also, collect 15 Golded Pumpkins and 30 Golded Ears o' Corn then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

We have a helpdesk ticket here requesting another round of bans, exactly like the previous round. I want you to take care of it.

I need you to find the farms on Level 3, the branch off of Level 3, Level 4, and the branch off of Level 4, banish the farmers there, and collect more golded vegetables. When you have done this return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

Keep it up, Dungeon Runner. We are winning the war one repeatable quest at a time. Let me know when you are up to try this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Locate the Farm on Level 3
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 3
  • Locate the Farm on Level 3 Branch
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 3 Branch
  • Locate the Farm on Level 4
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 4
  • Locate the Farm on Level 4 Branch
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 4 Branch
  • Golded Pumpkins ×15
  • Golded Ears o' Corn ×30

Level range: 89–91
